title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Sofia Morales
description: Context: provide first-class RAG/agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples for developers so teams can prototype retrieval-augmented agents quickly. Motivation: reduce onboarding time and support load, provide vetted templates for common patterns (FAQ bot, ticket assistant, knowledge search) and demonstrate tool-calling integration (HTTP tools, DB lookup, external search) with Redwood's streaming and structured-output features. Changes: added RAG agent templates under docs/quickstarts, three runnable examples in redwood-examples (python, ts, go), updated docs site sidebar and TOC, added smoke tests and CI doc-build checks, fixed a few runtime shims in examples to match latest SDK. Checklist: [x] add RAG templates; [x] add tool-calling quickstarts; [x] runnable python/ts/go examples; [x] update docs site nav; [x] add smoke tests and CI links; [x] add release notes. Related: ENG-4821 links to internal evaluation task and PM-759 for product-facing quickstart guidance.
commits: feat(docs): add RAG agent templates and overview
feat(examples): add python and typescript tool-calling quickstarts
feat(examples): add go minimal RAG example
chore(docs): update sidebar, TOC and versioned docs mapping
test(ci): add smoke tests for examples + doc build check
fix(examples): align SDK calls with latest beta API
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Please add a short troubleshooting section for the common auth error when using local KMS; also call out required model variants for consistent latency. Action: added troubleshooting subsection and noted recommended models in docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md.

Priya Nair: Can we include a minimal test that runs headless and validates the tool-calling JSON schema so CI can catch regressions? Action: added tests/examples/test_rag_examples.py with a lightweight JSON schema assertion and mocked tool endpoints.
Maya Thompson: Docs build link-checker failed on first run due to a temporary external CDN timeout; reran CI and everything passed. Approved with minor nits on copy.
release_notes: Added RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples (Python/TS/Go). Docs sidebar updated. New CI smoke tests for examples included. This adds developer-facing templates to accelerate RAG adoption.
